skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of accounting information systems, the role of accountants in these systems, and the development cycle of accounting information systems.
Apply knowledge to organize accounting documents, accounts, and ledgers.
Organize and manage databases in a business context.
Describe accounting information systems using various tools and evaluate their differences.
Develop critical thinking skills to improve processes and apply accounting methods and policies.
Utilize Microsoft Office products to organize, design, and present accounting information systems.
Understand and apply enterprise resource planning systems in accounting.
Organize planning, coordination, and management of resources to evaluate and improve activities.
